projects.title: Human Detection in Animated Movies
projects.bodyText:
- Built a YOLOv8 computer-vision pipeline for animated human detection
- Improved portfolio-reported performance by **+6% vs baseline**
- Thesis experiments reached **76.1% mAP@50** after preprocessing/augmentation
- Cross-domain tests up to **89.3% mAP@50**
- Tech: Python, PyTorch, YOLOv8, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Streamlit, Real-ESRGAN, hash/cosine duplicate filtering, model-assisted labeling, transfer learning

projects.title: Green Travel Mobile App - AI, Backend, and Blockchain Prototype
projects.bodyText:
- Built mobility workflows for trip uploads, maps, rewards, analytics, emissions tracking, and AI-assisted transportation-mode detection
- Deployed a sensor-classification API with **97.83% accuracy** on collected test data and **93.48% accuracy** on Kaggle test data using NN/CNN variants
- Tech: React Native, TypeScript, Firebase Cloud Functions, Firestore, PostgreSQL/Cloud SQL, FastAPI, Docker, REST APIs, Polygon Amoy, Solidity/Hardhat, wallet/reward contracts

projects.title: Web Vulnerability Defense - Pentesting Mini E-Business

projects.title: DNA Storage - Locally Balanced Constraints
projects.bodyText:
- Implementation and verification suite for locally balanced binary string constraints based on Ge22 paper
- Validated Sections IV & V through automated testing, graph algorithms, and mathematical recurrence verification
- Implemented Algorithm 1 graph-based optimal rate search and Theorem 2 recurrence verification
- Computed Shannon capacity using spectral radius
- Interactive React-based visualization demos

projects.title: App Selling Code Game
projects.bodyText:
- Built website using NodeJS to sell code Game for client
- Built SQL scripts to preprocess raw data and populate data in PostgreSQL database
- Built CRUD operations on multiple components with PostgreSQL database
- Integrated project with Docker and SSO from Facebook and Google API
- Applied Agile methodologies with 6-week Sprint delivery

projects.title: Food Supply Chain - Blockchain
projects.bodyText:
- Built web app using TypeScript and GO
- Modified open-source Hyperledger Fabric code to establish network in GO
- Used 3 organizations: Manufacturer, Distributor and Retailer
- Built smart contracts and ledger to store data in CouchDB
- Built REST API for different organizers
- Automated network building, chaincode installation with bash scripts

projects.title: CPU Scheduling Algorithm
projects.bodyText:
- Created a desktop application providing essential graphs for calculating various CPU scheduling algorithms
- Developed the UI using Swing GUI
- Calculated waiting times, turnaround times, and their averages responsively
- Wrote unit tests to check the correctness of each algorithm
- Drew Gantt Charts to depict the scheduling progress
- Implemented scheduling algorithms for CPU and I/O and performed calculations

projects.title: KenKen Puzzle Android Mobile Game
projects.bodyText:
- Designed a Simple Java Kotlin Android Mobile Game Application
- Applied Java and Kotlin to construct the game's logic on the console before migrating to Android
- Utilized the Model-View-Controller-ViewModel (MVCVM) architecture
- Leveraging XML layouts and Android Studio's drag-and-drop editor for a user-centric design
- Sets up observers on LiveData objects to automatically update the UI in response to data changes
